items.value: Hi Digitorium, I want to talk about a project.
Do I have to buy more than one service?
No. Plenty of clients come for one thing. The advantage of one team shows up when you need two, because the ad, the page and the shoot are planned together.
Who will I actually talk to?
The person doing the work. You will not be passed to an account manager who relays your brief to someone else.
It depends on scope. We quote in writing after one call, with the work listed line by line. There are no packages.
Do you sub-contract any of it?
No. Design, code, ads, camera and edit all sit under one roof.
The person on the call is the person doing the work. That is why the work matches the brief.
Send us your site or ad account. We tell you what is leaking, in writing, before money changes hands.
The reel, the landing page and the ad copy are made by the same hands, so they match.
Reports come from your own ad account and analytics. If a month was bad, the report says so.

Websites, custom software, Meta and Google ads, SEO, photo and video shoots, and branding. All of it done in-house in Ahmedabad, for clients from Gota to the rest of the world. Nothing gets sub-contracted.
Clients in India, Canada, the Congo and elsewhere

title: Pick one. Or let them work together.

items.value: Pick one. Or let them work together.
Not sure which one you need?
An ad agency, a web developer and a videographer will each do their part well. Then nobody owns the gap between them, and that gap is where the leads leak.
Want one team on the whole thing?
Send us what you have now.
Question not here? Ask us directly.
Show us what is not working
Send us your site or your ad account. We will tell you where the money is leaking, before you pay us anything.
